details.s: Elwing also known as Elwing the White, was the Half-elven daughter of Dior the Fair and his wife Nimloth. She was the younger sister of the twin brothers Eluréd and Elurín. She became the wife of another Half-elf, Eärendil the Mariner, and was the mother of Elrond and Elros.
f: Princess of Doriath, Lady of Arvernien
